alsoMeasured: One raster-window worker per dispatcher (processing.ts): 11.3 s for small-1 part 0.
Reading the surface from stored parts before the upload ends: the raster reader opens the retained source
(rasterSourceTx); a part-range read could save up to the transfer remainder plus assembly, only if the
first window bytes lie in early parts; the internal layout of the files was not read. Part size 8 MiB: the
fixed per-part cost is not separable here (minimum 0.16 s server, 0.15 s browser per part); not measured.

why: At the best measured part-path rate (16.73 MB/s) its bytes alone take 43.9 s; both large GeoTIFFs
(1,193,937,489 bytes) take 71.4 s, so sent after large-2 its last byte arrives after 60 s. Sent first,
43.9 s plus its measured first window (10.3 s) and about 3.6 s dispatch and map is 57.9 s before any hash
or assembly; the best measured assembly rate (34.77 MB/s) adds 21.1 s. Whole-file retention before
reading cannot fit 60 s on this PC; only a read from early stored parts could, layout not read.
